title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-21
lineage: mc> tc we435> soundcard> cdwave 44100/stereo/16 bit> traders little helper encoding option 8

ai_review.summary: Stunning front‑of‑house capture of a high‑energy show featuring Playin', China Cat Sunflower, and He's Gone.
ai_review.review: The recording is an FOB tape made by Jim Wise using Sennheiser 421 microphones, which many listeners describe as surprisingly clear and even "stunning" in sound quality. The performance itself shines with standout renditions of Playin', China Cat Sunflower, and He's Gone, delivering a high‑energy vibe throughout the set.

ai_rating.rationale: One reviewer rates the show and sound as exceptional (5 stars) while another gives a zero rating, indicating uncertainty about recording quality; overall the musical performance is praised, leading to a solid but not unanimous high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Front‑of‑house (FOB) tape recorded by Jim Wise with Sennheiser 421 microphones; praised for clear, 'stunning' sound despite being an audience source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Positive flow with highlighted jams; no reported issues.
